name: Circle Yetu
description: Creator platform for turning a bio into a storefront, with digital products, 1-on-1 bookings, direct tips, and M-Pesa or card payments built in.
longDescription:
Circle Yetu helps creators turn their bio into a bank account. The platform lets creators sell e-books, templates, courses, and other digital products with automatic email delivery after M-Pesa or card payment. Creators can also take 1-on-1 bookings that sync with Google Calendar and collect direct tips through M-Pesa.

Results in the first week after launch on 20 October 2026: creators made 64 sales worth KSh 5,685 through their stores. 17 creators signed up and 15 listed a product. The admin dashboard shows where creators stop: only 24% send their ID for verification, so that step is the next one to fix.
